entities.name: Anaba spirit crafters
entities.description: Mostly male Anaba minotaur shamans of the Koskun Mountains who commune with spirits and preserve the tribe's songs.

entities.name: Anaba

events.summary: A great earthquake destroys the pictoglyph caverns, losing most of the Minotaurs' history.
events.quote: When the great earthquake destroyed the pictoglyph caverns, most of the history of the Minotaurs was lost.

relations.quote: like the rest of their Minotaur tribe
